description.text: Materials engineering is an interdisciplinary subject based on the theory of materials science, which studies the preparation process, performance optimization, application development and engineering issues of materials. Its core lies in solving key technical problems from laboratory research and development to industrial production of materials through theories from multiple disciplines such as physics, chemistry, and mechanics. It covers fields such as metallic materials, ceramic materials, polymer materials, composite materials, and functional materials, and serves as the fundamental support for modern industries like aerospace, electronic information, energy, and healthcare.

duration.text: The Materials engineering at Guangdong University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) A foreigner's ordinary passport valid for more than one year or a currently valid visa in China.(2) Highest academic degree certificate (original and notarized in Chinese or English). Fresh graduates can provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their university. Those who fail to obtain their graduation certificates before enrollment will have their admission qualifications revoked.(3) A complete official transcript of the study stage provided by the highest academic degree school (original and notarized in Chinese or English).(4) Personal statement and a brief research plan (within 800 words). Applicants for doctoral programs are also required to submit a brief research experience.(5) Two recommendation letters from associate professors or those with corresponding professional titles or above.Applicants who studied in China during their previous educational stage are required to provide proof of their performance at school.(7) A pre-approval letter for acceptance issued by the graduate supervisor of the intended major (Attachment 3). Those who have not yet determined the pre-accepted supervisor and meet the application requirements will enter the interview and assessment process in accordance with the relevant regulations of the school's postgraduate recruitment.(8) Physical examination report (The examination results must have a valid official seal and be valid for 6 months).

requirements.text: 1. Foreign citizens who are physically and mentally healthy and of good conduct. Applicants for master's degree programs must have a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree in China, and applicants for doctoral degree programs must have a degree equivalent to a master's degree in China. No criminal record. During the study period in China, I voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations, respect Chinese social morality and customs, and refrain from engaging in any activities that are inconsistent with my student status.2.
